embeds.title: Aramaki's Theme Editor
embeds.description:
### Visual theme editors for **Tinfoil** and the **RomM Switch client**
*Two editors. Two apps. One page.*

`🔵 RomM client` `🔴 Tinfoil` `🌐 runs in browser` `🟣 Windows desktop app` `🟢 Android & iOS` `📜 MIT`

No installs. No command line. Drag in a theme and start editing — live Switch UI preview as you type, export a ready-to-use pack in one click.

embeds.title: 🧾 What is this?
embeds.description:
Two self-contained web apps in one repo, for theming two different Switch apps. No hand-editing raw JSON and guessing what a field does — load a theme, tweak every field through a proper UI, preview it live, export it back out.

Everything runs **entirely in your browser** (or as a desktop app). Nothing you open ever leaves your machine.

fields.name: What the editor does for you
fields.value:
• **Browse the published catalog** and open any theme with its assets
• **Live preview of the real screens** at the console's 1280×720
• **Motion that actually plays** — a port of the client's own arithmetic
• **20 starting palettes** + **WCAG readability checks**
• **Live memory budget** for animated backgrounds
• Import a folder, `.zip` or `theme.json` · export a ready-to-drop pack
